long_biography.plain_text:
Jacqueline Pino Wechsler has participated directly in residential development applications. She and Solomon Wechsler jointly sought approval for a new South Miami house through their development company. Following review of the proposed frontage, the project's architect revised the garage position and covered entrance, responding to the design board's concerns before the application returned for further consideration.

She also contributed to Breakthrough Miami's Race to Breakthrough campaign in 2023. The virtual fundraiser brought together participants across multiple countries to support the organisation's educational work. Its collective proceeds covered a year of programming for 50 scholars.
